html.body: Date: 2025-04-23 Apple. No. 18/134,995 37 C.F.R. § 1.312 Amendment REMARKS/ARGUMENTSClaims 1-2, 5-12, and 15-20 are pending in this application. Claims 2, 5- 10, 12, and 15-20 have been amended, without waiver. Applicant respectfully requests that the Primary Examiner recommend entry of the amendments to the claims, which are submitted with the payment of the issue fee, in accordance with 37 C.F.R. § 1.312. Applicant points out that the amendments are merely formal in nature and do not materially impact the scope of the claims. In light of the forgoing, entry of the amendment and issuance of the claims is earnestly solicited. The Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at (402) 496-0300 with any issues related to the above amendments.Respectfully submitted, By: han i sannes/ Ian J. Sannes Reg.
